blocks.title: Testing
blocks.text: Once the software has been developed, it undergoes testing: checking the software to identify any bugs, errors or issues. It is a quality check to make sure everything works as expected; the software is run under various conditions to see whether it behaves correctly.

items: Functionality testing: all features work according to the specifications.
Performance testing: the software performs well under different conditions, such as high traffic or heavy data.
Compatibility testing: the software works well on various devices and operating systems.

blocks.text: Testing helps identify hidden issues that were not apparent during development. By fixing them, developers make sure the software runs smoothly and meets the user's needs, giving a better and more reliable experience.

blocks.prompt: Explain why the testing phase is important in the SDLC and give two reasons (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: Testing finds bugs and hidden issues before users meet them, and it confirms that the software meets its specifications, performs under load and works on different devices; fixing problems at this stage is cheaper than after release and gives users a reliable product.

items: Testing: checking the developed software for bugs, errors and issues under various conditions.
Types here: functionality, performance and compatibility testing; it finds hidden issues and makes the software reliable.
